name: Custom Islands
author: FranzFischer78 + MegaMatrixs
description: Build your own islands in an in-game editor and find them while sailing! Sculpt terrain or generate a whole island from a seed (sizes, heights, coasts, reefs and plants measured from Raft's own islands, or a variation of one of them), pick a style (tropical, snowy, desert, forest, volcanic) and place any of Raft's 1,900 objects - even build your own abandoned rafts. Give islands life: Raft's animals with your own toughness and colour, notes, chests with loot, trigger zones and ambushes, fog and sounds, doors and levers, quests, story items and a journal, and islands that bring new islands. World plans decide which islands a world gets, from random islands to a story from island to island. The New Game box adds a world randomizer (animal colours, alphas, moved loot, oddity islands, boss lairs, large islands with dens), monster difficulty and build cost. Works in multiplayer: every player gets the host's islands and settings. Illustrated guide: https://github.com/SwedenJohansson/DynamicIslands/blob/master/docs/GUIDE.md
